note: Bow shooting (plan 4b, tech/ACTION_PLANS/Steve_bow_shoot.md): ACT_SHOOT a = bow slot, b = draw time in ms (the client measures; the server clamps it and checks the pace), at = aim direction. A draw under draw_min_ms is a weak shot at weak_power; from draw_min_ms to draw_max_ms the power rises from min_power to 1. speed = speed_max x power (m/s), the arrow falls under gravity 9.8 and stops at range_m of flight, the ground, or the first animal on its path (hit_radius_m round its chest). damage = the arrow's damage x power x aim.damage_mult at the bow skill. Shot noise alarms animals within noise_m. A landed arrow is a world item again unless it breaks: break_chance by tip, x hit_break_mult when it hit an animal, lost water_loss of the time in water; luck applies (fate). ACT_SHOOT count = the arrow item the bow is loaded with (dragged onto the bow on the hotbar); 0 or one the pack lacks: the first id in `ammo` the pack holds. Quivers are not read yet: arrows are taken from the pack.
bows_note: Each bow against the plain wooden bow (Jamie #933): speed_mult on the arrow's speed at full draw (speed_max), damage_mult on its damage, range_mult on its flight cap (range_m). A bow with no row shoots like the wooden bow. The longbow: a taller, heavier stave stores more energy, so its arrow leaves faster (about 54 m/s against 45, as a heavy self bow against a short one), hits harder (energy goes as speed squared, about 1.44; 1.4 here) and flies further (range_m 120). Estimates. The sling (item_system.md: 1 Hide, 1 Twine; ammo Sling stone) is drawn and loosed like a bow: its stone leaves at about 32 m/s (a hand sling), reaches 60 m and hits a little softer than an arrow; it takes only sling stones (its own ammo list), never sticks in a trunk (it drops at the foot), and says its own lines. A sling stone's tip is stone_shot (break_chance 0.05).

sling.say_not_ammo: That is not a stone this sling can throw.

stuck_note: An arrow that hits a tree trunk sticks in it at the hit point (Dave 10 Nov 2026: "there should be an arrow in that tree until I collect it or it fades out in 5 minutes"): it stays stuck_s seconds unless picked up. It breaks at the arrow's break_chance, as one landing on the ground.
say_weak: You loose it too soon; the arrow barely flies.
aim_note: Dave 10 Nov 2026 (the bow): hold the right mouse button to raise the bow and draw (draw time as above), left click looses, letting right go lowers it with no shot. Every curve is [[bow skill level 0..100 (the hunting skill's working level), value], ...], straight lines between. steady_s: how long the aim stays still once drawn; then the aim sways by wobble_deg_per_s more each second up to wobble_max_deg, at wobble_hz. The sway turns the whole view and the reticle stays in the middle of the screen (Dave 10 Nov 2026: "the whole screen should move like that but much less"), so it is a third of what the reticle moved before (wobble_max_deg 4 to 1.2, wobble_deg_per_s 1.5/0.8/0.3 to 0.5/0.27/0.1). pull: the share of the way the view is drawn to a vital zone (zones: metres forward of the animal's middle and up from its feet) within pull_cone_deg of the aim; no skill, no pull. spread_deg: the server turns each shot by up to this much at random (luck narrows it). damage_mult: the arrow's damage times this. zoom_fov_share: the view narrows to this share of the field of view while drawn. reticle_px: the cross's arm length.
say_not_ammo: That is not an arrow this bow can shoot.
